subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 5: -at words (cat, mat, fat, sat); Week 6: -an words (pan, fan, can, van); segment, blend and write the words

show.line: Words in the an family! Pan, fan, can, van. They all end with an.

rounds.prompt: Listen. p, a, n. What word is it?
Which word is in the an family?
Is it in the an family or the at family? Sort the words.

hints: Look at the end. Is it an or at?
Change the first sound. p-an, f-an, v-an.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that rhymes with fan.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Fat ends with at. Can rhymes with fan.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Fan, can. Same at the end!

parent_line: Can read and build words in the an family: pan, fan, can, van.
